description: AL Language debug configuration for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Auto-generated from VS Code AL extension v16.3.2065053.

enumDescriptions: Build, publish, and debug the extension
Attach debugger to a running Business Central session
Initialize a snapshot debugging session

serverInstance.description: The server instance to connect to.

tenant.description:
The tenant to connect to.
For an on-premise server, this parameter must contain a tenant name, for example: MyTenant.
For a cloud server, this parameter must contain the Microsoft Entra tenant ID or Primary Domain associated with the Microsoft Entra tenant, for example: bf4ab6d6-cd93-424e-91fa-afe03fa286ac or mycustomer.onmicrosoft.com

primaryTenantDomain.description: Specifies the Tenant ID or Primary Domain associated with the Microsoft Entra tenant, for example: bf4ab6d6-cd93-424e-91fa-afe03fa286ac or mycustomer.onmicrosoft.com. This setting is used to enable Microsoft Entra ID authentication for on-premises installations.

applicationFamily.description: The application family in the cloud server, for example: Fabrikam. This property is reserved for Embed Apps.

enumDescriptions: Microsoft Enta ID
Microsoft Entra ID
Windows
Username and Password.
Specifies an onprem environment
Specifies a sandbox environment
Specifies a production environment
environmentType.description: Specifies which environment to use to connect to Business Central.

environmentName.description: Specifies which production, or sandbox environment to use.

sandboxName.description: Specifies which sandbox to use in cases where multiple sandboxes are owned by the same tenant.
sandboxName.deprecationMessage: This setting is obsoleted. Please use the 'sandbox' environmentType and the environmentName settings instead.

validateServerCertificate.description: If the value is set to false, the server certificate will not be validated.

startupObjectId.description: Specifies the ID of the object which should be opened after publishing.

startupObjectType.description: Specifies the type of the object which should be opened after publishing.

startupCompany.description: Specifies the name of the company which should be opened after publishing.

enumDescriptions: Synchronize the schema and fail on incompatible schema changes.
Recreate the tables, and table extensions and lose all data stored in them.
ForceSync is similar to Synchronize in data will be preserved in almost all cases while giving more freedom to make schema changes.
schemaUpdateMode.description: Specifies the update mode to use when the extension is already installed.

enumDescriptions: Dependency publishing will be applied.
Dependency publishing is ignored so that only leaf projects are published.
Dependency publishing will fail if there are any apps that directly depend on the startup project and these apps are not part of the workspace.
dependencyPublishingOption.description: Specifies the publishing option to use. By specifying the Ignore option, only the current project is published, dependencies are ignored. By specifying the Strict option, publishing will fail if the project has apps that not part of the workspace and depend on it

launchBrowser.description: If the value is set to true, the browser tab is launched, if false, the browser tab is not launched. If publishing with debugging enabled, the browser tab is launched and this setting is ignored. The default value is true.

usePublicURLFromServer.description: If the value is set to true, the browser will be launched with the URL provided by the PublicWebBaseURL set by the server. If false, it will use the server defined in the launch configuration.

disableHttpRequestTimeout.description: Turn off Visual Studio Code's HTTP request timeout and allow for requests to run with infinite timeout.

snapshotFileName.description: The name of the snapshot file

enumDescriptions: Does not break on any errors
Breaks on all errors
Does not break on any errors
Breaks on all errors
Breaks on errors that are not contained within a Try block
breakOnError.description: Specifies whether the debugger to break on the next error

enumDescriptions: Does not break on record changes
Breaks on all record changes
Does not break on record changes
Breaks on all record changes
Ignores changes to temporary records
breakOnRecordWrite.description: Specifies whether the debugger breaks on record changes.

enumDescriptions: Break on the next Web Service request.
Break on the next Web client session.
Break on the next background session.
breakOnNext.description: Specifies that attach should break on the next available client session.

enableSqlInformationDebugger.description: Specifies whether the debugger shows the SQL Information in the debugger.

enableLongRunningSqlStatements.description: Specifies whether the debugger enables or disables long running SQL statements in the debugger window.

longRunningSqlStatementsThreshold.description: Sets the number of milliseconds spent before a SQL statement is considered as long running in the debugger.

numberOfSqlStatements.description: Sets the number of SQL statements to be shown in the debugger.

forceUpgrade.description: Always run upgrade codeunits, even if the version number of the extension is the same as an already installed version.

useSystemSessionForDeployment.description: Runs install and upgrade codeunits in a system session. This will prevent debugging install and upgrade codeunits.

userId.description: Specifies the end user id who will first connect to perform debugging session. It can be either a username or GUID.

sessionId.description: The id of the session to be attached to.

enumDescriptions: Only allow stepping to lines with SnapPoints.
Allows stepping through every line executed.
snapshotVerbosity.description: Specifies the verbosity level of snapshot data. If SnapPoint is specified then stacktraces and line information will only be gathered on snap points.

enumDescriptions: A flag that no profile data is collected
A flag that only a profiling session is performed, snappoints will be ignored.
Both debugging and profiling is performed
executionContext.description: Specifies how the snapshot technology will be applied on the Business Central server executing AL code

enumDescriptions: If profiling is enabled than the all frames as executed will be measured for their total time.
If profiling is enabled than frames will be collected and aggregated based on a sample interval. This option can only be used with the executionContext set to profiling.
profilingType.description: Specifies the profiling type to be used.

profileSamplingInterval.description: Specifies the sampling interval in milliseconds when "Sampling" profiling type is specified. Default is 100ms.
